verdict.rationale: Lambda's documented product is on-demand/reserved GPU VM instances, 1-Click Clusters, Managed Slurm, and Managed Kubernetes—billed hourly by instance, not a serverless-endpoint model that autoscales workers to zero. Community evidence (lambda-labs-comm-1) confirms the opposite: Lambda does not distinguish idle vs in-use, billing continuously ($583 for an idle GH200 instance), directly undermining any scale-to-zero claim.
